text_en: One day Peter and John were going up to the temple at the hour of prayer, at three o’clock in the afternoon.
text_cn: 伯多禄和若望在祈祷的时辰，即第九时辰，上圣殿去。

text_en: And a man lame from birth was being carried in. People would lay him daily at the gate of the temple called the Beautiful Gate so that he could ask for alms from those entering the temple.
text_cn: 有一个人从母胎中就瘸了；每天有人抬他来，放在名叫丽门的殿门前，好向进圣殿的人求施舍。

text_en: When he saw Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked them for alms.
text_cn: 他看见伯多禄和若望要进圣殿，便求他们给一点施舍。

text_en: Peter looked intently at him, as did John, and said, “Look at us. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄和若望定睛看着他说：“你看我们！”

text_en: And he fixed his attention on them, expecting to receive something from them.
text_cn: 他就注目看他们，希望得点什么。

text_en: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have I give you; in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, stand up and walk. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄却说：“银子和金子，我没有；但把我所有的给你：因纳匝肋人耶稣基督的名字，你【起来】行走罢！”

text_en: And he took him by the right hand and raised him up; and immediately his feet and ankles were made strong.
text_cn: 于是握住他的右手，拉他起来；他的脚和踝骨就立即强壮了。

text_en: Jumping up, he stood and began to walk, and he entered the temple with them, walking and leaping and praising God.
text_cn: 他跳起来，能站立行走；遂同他们进入圣殿，随走随跳，赞美天主。

text_en: All the people saw him walking and praising God,
text_cn: 众百姓也都看见他行走赞美天主。

text_en: and they recognized him as the one who used to sit and ask for alms at the Beautiful Gate of the temple; and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
text_cn: 他们一认出他就是那坐在圣殿丽门前求施舍的人，就对他所遇到的事，满怀惊讶诧异。

text_en: While he clung to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the portico called Solomon’s Portico, utterly astonished.
text_cn: 当那人拉着伯多禄和若望的时候，众百姓都惊奇地跑到他们那里，即到名叫“撒罗满廊”下。

text_en: When Peter saw it, he addressed the people, “You Israelites, why do you wonder at this, or why do you stare at us, as though by our own power or piety we had made him walk?
text_cn: 伯多禄一见，就发言对百姓说：“诸位以色列人！你们为什么对这事惊奇？或者为什么注视我们，好像是我们因自己的能力或热心使他行走？

text_en: The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, the God of our ancestors has glorified his servant Jesus, whom you handed over and rejected in the presence of Pilate, though he had decided to release him.
text_cn: 亚巴郎、依撒格和雅各伯的天主，我们祖先的天主，光荣了自己的仆人耶稣，他就是你们所解送，并在比拉多前所否认的；虽然那人原判定要释放他，

text_en: But you rejected the Holy and Righteous One and asked to have a murderer given to you,
text_cn: 你们却否认了那圣而且义的人，竟要求把杀人犯，恩赐给你们，

text_en: and you killed the Author of life, whom God raised from the dead. To this we are witnesses.
text_cn: 反而杀害了生命之原；天主却从死者中复活了他，我们就是这事的见证人。

text_en: And by faith in his name, his name itself has made this man strong, whom you see and know; and the faith that is through Jesus has given him this perfect health in the presence of all of you.
text_cn: 因我们信仰他的名，他的名就强壮了你们所看见，所认识的这人：即由他而来的信德，在你们众人面前赐这人完全好了。

text_en: “And now, friends, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
text_cn: 现今，弟兄们！我知道你们所行的，是出于无知；你们的首领也是如此。

text_en: In this way God fulfilled what he had foretold through all the prophets, that his Messiah would suffer.
text_cn: 但天主藉着众先知的口，预言他的默西亚当受难的事，也就这样应验了。

text_en: Repent therefore, and turn to God so that your sins may be wiped out,
text_cn: 你们悔改，并回心转意罢！好消除你们的罪过，

text_en: so that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord, and that he may send the Messiah appointed for you, that is, Jesus,
text_cn: 为的是使安乐的时期由上主面前来到，他好给你们派遣已预定的默西亚耶稣，

text_en: who must remain in heaven until the time of universal restoration that God announced long ago through his holy prophets.
text_cn: 因为他必须留在天上，直到万物复兴的时候；对此，天主藉着他古圣先知的口早已说过了。

text_en: Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you from your own people a prophet like me. You must listen to whatever he tells you.
text_cn: 梅瑟说过：‘上主，我们的天主，要从你们的弟兄们中，给你们兴起一位像我一样的先知，你们应在他吩咐的一切事上听从他。

text_en: And it will be that everyone who does not listen to that prophet will be utterly rooted out of the people. ’
text_cn: 将来无论谁，若不听从那位先知，必从民间铲除。’

text_en: And all the prophets, as many as have spoken, from Samuel and those after him, also predicted these days.
text_cn: 其实，所有的先知，自撒慕尔起，及以后讲话的先知，都预言了这些日子。

text_en: You are the descendants of the prophets and of the covenant that God gave to your ancestors, saying to Abraham, ‘And in your descendants all the families of the earth shall be blessed. ’
text_cn: 你们是先知和盟约之子，那盟约是天主与你们的祖先所订立的，因他曾向亚巴郎说：‘地上万民，都要因你的后裔，获得祝福。’

text_en: When God raised up his servant, he sent him first to you, to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways. ”
text_cn: 天主先给你们兴起他的仆人，派他来祝福你们，使你们个个归依，脱离你们的邪恶。”
